# Definite

> > Definite is an AI-native data analytics platform that connects to modern data stacks (Snowflake, DuckDB, PostgreSQL) and provides natural language querying, visualization, and Python/SQL analysis capabilities.

Definite positions itself as a next-generation frontend for the modern data stack, offering 10x faster analytics through AI-powered features. The platform integrates with popular data sources like Stripe, HubSpot, and Salesforce, while leveraging technologies like DuckDB for high-performance querying and supporting both SQL and Python for flexible data analysis.

## Key Topics

- Modern Data Stack
- DuckDB
- AI-Native Analytics
- Natural Language Queries
- Data Warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift)
- ETL Tools (Fivetran, Airbyte)
- Business Intelligence
- Data Visualization
- Semantic Layer
- Apache Iceberg
- Real-Time Analytics
- Python & SQL Analysis
- Data Integration (Stripe, HubSpot, Salesforce)
- Cloud Data Warehouse Costs
- OLAP Query Engines

## DuckDB & Query Engines

- [DuckDB vs Trino: The Full Comparison](https://www.definite.app/blog/duckdb-vs-trino-comparison): In-depth comparison of DuckDB vs Trino query engines for data analytics
- [Is DuckDB Open Source?](https://www.definite.app/blog/duckdb-open-source): Explanation of DuckDB's MIT open-source license and OLAP capabilities
- [Duckdb and Iceberg](https://www.definite.app/blog/iceberg-query-engine): Guide to using DuckDB as query engine for Apache Iceberg lakehouses
- [Duck Takes Flight](https://www.definite.app/blog/duck-takes-flight): Tutorial on streaming with DuckDB and Apache Arrow Flight for real-time data
- [DuckLake: This is your Data Lake on ACID](https://www.definite.app/blog/ducklake): Tutorial on building event pipelines with DuckLake for ACID transactions
